content.en: Use the 1–4 player board, reveal the **Imperium Row** and a Conflict, then prepare Contracts and each Leader's starting deck.
content.zh: 使用 1–4 人主板，翻出**帝国牌列**与冲突牌，再准备契约及每位领袖的起始牌库。

content.en: **Play 1 card → place 1 Agent → resolve.** Agent icons make a location legal. Combat locations let you commit troops.
content.zh: **打 1 张牌 → 派 1 名特工 → 结算。** 特工图标决定地点是否合法；冲突地点可投入部队。

content.en: A Spy stays on a space. On a later turn, remove it to send an Agent there despite normal occupancy. Complete Contract requirements to claim their rewards.
content.zh: 间谍留在地点上；日后移走它，即可无视通常占位把特工派入。达成契约条件后领取其奖励。

alt.en: A Spy opens an occupied location to your Agent
alt.zh: 间谍让你的特工进入被占用地点

content.en: Reveal the rest of your hand, resolve **Reveal** effects, and add swords to strength. Buy up to one eligible Imperium or Reserve card.
content.zh: 揭示手中余牌，结算**揭示**效果，并把剑加入战力；最多购买 1 张可买的帝国牌或储备牌。

content.en: Rank strength from troops, swords, and effects. Award rewards in order. A player with a committed Sandworm doubles the reward they earn when its text permits.
content.zh: 比较部队、剑和效果组成的战力，依次发奖励。投入沙虫的玩家在奖励牌文允许时，将自己获得的奖励翻倍。

alt.en: A Sandworm can double a Conflict reward
alt.zh: 沙虫可使冲突奖励翻倍

content.en: 2 Influence draws Intrigue; 4 can secure an Alliance and 1 VP. Intrigue stays hidden until its listed timing.
content.zh: 影响力到 2 摸阴谋牌；到 4 可取得同盟与 1 分。阴谋牌在列明的时机前保密。

content.en: Advance Maker hooks, harvest when they reach Sandworms, then recall Agents and draw five. At **10 VP**, finish the round and score Alliances, Objectives and endgame effects.
content.zh: 前进制造者钩，到沙虫时收获，再召回特工并摸 5 张。有人到 **10 分**后完成整轮，结算同盟、目标与终局效果。
